reviews.text: I cannot say enough wonderful things about Sheldon Dog Services Ltd and specifically about Abi, who grooms my sometimes temperamental dog Cyril with exceptional skill and care. Abi's patience and expertise shine through in every grooming session, and I am consistently impressed by her ability to handle my dog with such grace and understanding. The results are always outstanding, and my furry friend leaves looking and feeling his best. I am grateful for the excellent service provided by Sheldon Dog Services and highly recommend them to any pet owner looking for top-notch grooming services. Thank you, Abi, for your exceptional work!

I have been using the Social Dog walk service on a Saturday morning for a little over 6 months. The social dog walk allows for dog owners to come together as a community group and walk there dogs through Sheldon Country Park every Saturday Morning. It provides great opportunity for dogs and people to socialise while learning valuable tips and tricks in terms of training and dog behaviour. There is always an instructor/Trainer in hand to offer advice and support but also to provide valuable insight into dog behaviour and how to address common issues and problems. My German Shepherd has benefitted massively from attending these walks and will no doubt continue to benefit long into the future and I have no doubt the knowledge and guidance gained will likely contribute to positive behaviours in our new puppy GSD. It is a great opportunity to meet like minded people and also learn about other dog breeds but also know that you are not alone in dealing with various dog related issues problems. I really do recommend this service to anyone and would encourage you to reach out to Sheldon Dog Services to discuss how to join the social walks. Thank you so much for all that you have done for Evo and Mitzy and I look forward to seeing you on the Saturday Social Walks

I was struggling with anxiety which resulted in my pup becoming extremely nervous but the social walks gave us the right environment to grow Shane Connor will help you enjoy walking your dog. Beautiful surroundings too

We went to Shane with a very reactive rescue dog. He suggested we went on the social walks and it’s the best decision we have made. There is always a trainer with us mainly Shane or Connor to give advice and encouragement. Our dog is still reactive but going on the social walks have helped tremendously and given us confidence to deal with reactive situations, also we are not judged and it’s a very friendly group.

Highly recommend Shane and his other trainers after being dragged into my first training session by a very large playful Bully nearly in tears, I can honestly say Shane changed our lives! We still go to social walk on Saturday mornings over 3 years later putting the skills I have been taught to the test in real life walking situations. Having a 55kg dog that I can walk confidently on my own is something I dreamed of and thanks to these guys its a reality. Could not recommend these guys more!!
Excellent service and look after our 4 dogs brilliantly

OMG where do I start , I contacted sheldon dog services couple weeks ago desperately needing help for a behaviourist after one of my two little dogs started to react towards the other .
We had tried all different tactics with no luck , I was at my wits end and so upset how life had become having to keep my dogs separated.
That was until Shane came to visit us ...
What he explained really opened our eyes and literally made sense and we can see where we had been going wrong,  Shane really knows his stuff and explained to us so much information,  then he showed up the first steps in learning these new skills that we have to keep practising.
Shane only came to see us first time this morning , why have I left a review so early ?
Because wow we can honestly see a difference already in our dogs its only been a few hours , ok I know there's still long way to go n its going to take time and commitment to follow Shane's advise, but I cant thank this young man enough his knowledge and skills are on a different level I never thought possible,  but also the prices are affordable to the average working family like ourselves unlike some.
I highly recommend Shane , dont give up in your dog until to speak with him its a total game changer
So much respect for him and cant thank him enough
Amazing service. Would highly recommend 100%
Lovely staff very polite well knowledge about dogs well done
First time going there was really pleased how they looked after our dog xxxx
Just look at my beautiful boy and how happy he is after his grooming session , I'm glad I found this place and can highly recommend it to anyone ☺️
Thank you for looking after Dottie so well, she looks amazing. The staff are so patient with her in these difficult times, it is much appreciated

Really cannot recommend these guys enough, from the stuff they sell in store to the behaviour training & patience the groomers have… and the talent I have seen from some of the groomers too.

I’ve known the guys at Sheldon Dog Services for a long time, they’ve helped us on a few occasions with my own dog. But this time we went for something else.

However this weekend I took my partner in with his Lab for a 45minute training advice session after he’d reached a point where he confessed he needed help to give us an insight on where exactly to start with him (which ran over and Shane was super patient with us). It was a real eye opener, he took the time to explain in depth what the main problem was (and it was actually not down to what we originally thought) and ensured he explained to my partner how to actually go about starting this work in a way he would understand. Taking the time to actually explain what he meant, not just telling him things expecting him to just know - he made sure he had some understanding of what was being said. Very honest but also understanding and clear too.
The passion Shane has for dog training but also educating (and not belittling people) really does show & it does help in encouraging first time owners to do things better rather than just leaving them feeling overwhelmed and like they’ve failed and “that’s it”.

They don’t just want to take your money, do their bit just in their time with you and go on about their day… they actually care about you leaving with a better insight and an actual plan of where to start after the advice session. Instead of telling us to book in right away for another session for the basic things that he took time to explain how to start fixing, he gave us a plan of things to work on first ourselves over the next few weeks and then explained that once we have that sorted (and that he would be able to tell haha!)  we can then look to doing another session at home. They want to give the tools to train your dog and build that bond too, not just do it for you and leave you uneducated.

I know my partner came out of that shop feeling more positive about the whole situation because he now has understanding and more of an idea of where to start.
And that, as long as he puts that work in and is consistent those results will show. He got the exact help he was seeking - and that was exactly why when he said he needed help I was adamant he needed to try Sheldon Dog Services first.

The products they sell in store are also amazing (especially their natural treat range!) and I cannot fault them honestly, I’ve loved this store since it opened there and this weekend was just more of a reason.

If you’re genuinely wanting changes to come, and a confident trainer that’ll tell you how it is so you can make a start to changing things, I cannot recommend them enough.
Can't thank Abi enough,Benji looked fantastic after his groom, her and the rest of the team are always so helpful .

I can’t recommend Sheldon Dog Services enough, Abi and the team are really lovely. My dog can be quite reactive, and finding someone who understands her has been a challenge, but these guys absolutely smashed it - she’s had the best grooms she’s ever had here!
They even did a little Christmas photo shoot for her last time which was lovely, if you’re looking for a place that really goes above and beyond, this is definitely it!
Booked my dog for training took deposit then they cancelled never gave deposit back never offered to re book!!!
Excellent service, my dog is happy to go and comes home looking beautiful. Abi and team are talented , friendly and accomplished groomers.
Lovely staff and superb training , helped me understand how i could get my dog to have patience
What can I say, definitely the best around, great service excellent staff Friendly and patient even with nervous pooches, never had a bad experience with my two boys, very happy always.
We had a dog training session with Shane and it was brilliant. After just one 45 minutes session, our cocker’s recall is so much better. I thoroughly recommend him as a trainer.

Took my Samoyed here today. The best groom he's ever had. His coat was so thick with winter coat. He came out looking stunning. The amount of attention he got on the bus ride home was unbelievable. Booked in for another visit in 4 wks.
Excellent as usual, Fudge, Harley and Heffy my 3 Cocker Spaniels looked amazing again.

An absolute jewel in the crown. Very polite, well trained, attentative, compassionate, and supportive staff members. The staff listen to you and, more importantly, observe your dogs behaviour. My dog, who is nervous, absolutely loves being groomed by the staff, and for her, I wouldn't go anywhere else.

First time having our two dogs groomed here and very impressed with the service, staff are friendly and take good care of the dogs and any special needs they have. Competitively priced I was very pleased with how both dogs had been groomed and they even come out with a colorful bandana 🙂. Will be booking the dogs in again when the time comes and can fully recommend Sheldon Dog Services.
Had our Charlie cut for the first time at sheldon dog services very very happy with the out come Charlie looks great thanks to all the staff

I have taken my cockapoo puppy here twice now. My pup was very nervous at first.   The patience and attention  shown encouraged more confidence.in my little girl. Pup smells lovely and looks adorable. Thank you for the advice and look forward to pups next pamper day.

Took my shih tzu for his groom first time id used sheldon pet services and i was more than happy my boy looked amazing id shown them a picture of what i wanted and it was exactly what i got time was taken on his groom he smelt amazing i will most definitely be going back and can’t recommend them enough he even got a free bandana which was a lovely touch

We have been taking Teddy to Sheldon dog services to be groomed and I cannot recommend them enough! Teddy is very anxious, yet there has never been any issues with his groom and always comes out looking lovely. After having a bad experience …
